english.title: Disclose information obtained for purpose of Inland Revenue investigation to unauthorised person
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[for the purpose of assisting in the investigation of a matter]_
(B)_[with a view to the appointment of an investigator]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 352(1) and (2) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000.

english.notes:
(i) Section 350(5) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 permits disclosure by or under the authority of the Commissioners of Inland Revenue, in criminal proceedings brought against a person under the Act or the Criminal Justice Act 1993 as a result of an investigation under section 168 and in proceedings before the tribunal as a result of action taken against a person under that section or with a view to the institution of such proceedings.
(ii) Section 350(6) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 allows disclosure to the Authority or the Secretary of State.
(iii) Section 401 of the of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that proceedings for offences may be instituted in England and Wales only by the Authority or the Secretary of State or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.
(iv) In proceedings for an offence under Section 352 of the of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 it is a defence for the accused to prove:-
(a) that he did not know and had no reason to suspect that the information was confidential information or that it had been disclosed in accordance with section 350.
(b) that he took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
